heading: ## Scenario: an unarmed-until payload naming a closed work item is a conformance failure
reason: Ratified with the scenario in the role-key-declared-absent-spellings revision; the behavior is DELIBERATELY UNIMPLEMENTED, so no test of ANY tier exists and the integration-tier (`tests.consumer`) requirement is acknowledged as unmet. The verifier must resolve work-item identifiers ACROSS trackers, and no credential class in any current vantage can: the central fleet vantage holds a GitHub credential and reaches no ledger, while the local vantage holds ONE tenant's credential and live declarations cite two. A same-tenant resolver would report green while failing to resolve half the live declarations, which is the silent-consent shape this revision removes. Replace TODO once that vantage decision is made.
